name: papyrus-tools
description: Papyrus scripting support for Bethesda games: syntax highlighting, snippets, completions, and hovers.

papyrus.defaultGame.description: Choose your current game so Papyrus Tools knows which compiler and script paths to use, along with any game specific features.
papyrus.defaultGame.markdownDescription: Choose your current game so Papyrus Tools knows which compiler and script paths to use, along with any game specific features.

papyrus.games.markdownDescription: Per-game Papyrus settings managed automatically by Papyrus Tools commands (keys: `starfield`, `fallout`, `skyrim`).

papyrus.Fallout.autoDetect.description: Automatically detect Fallout 4 installation and script paths.
papyrus.Fallout.autoDetect.markdownDescription: Automatically detect **Fallout 4** installation and script paths.

papyrus.Fallout.ScriptSourceDirectory.description: Path to Papyrus scripts for Fallout 4.

papyrus.Fallout.compiler.Namespace.description: This is the Namespace or Working directory, inside the Data folder, that your scripts live and will be used when invoking the Fallout 4 Papyrus compiler. If not set, the directory of the script being compiled will be used.
papyrus.Fallout.compiler.Namespace.markdownDescription: This is the Namespace or Working directory, inside the Data folder, that your scripts live and will be used when invoking the **Fallout 4 Papyrus compiler**. If not set, the directory of the script being compiled will be used.

papyrus.Fallout.compiler.NamespaceFragme.description: This is the Namespace or Working directory, inside the Data folder, that your Fragment scripts live. Normally this will be Namespace/Fragments and will be used when invoking the Fallout 4 Papyrus compiler. If not set, the directory of the script being compiled will be used.
papyrus.Fallout.compiler.NamespaceFragme.markdownDescription: This is the Namespace or Working directory, inside the Data folder, that your Fragment scripts live. Normally this will be **Namespace/Fragments** and will be used when invoking the **Fallout 4 Papyrus compiler**. If not set, the directory of the script being compiled will be used.

papyrus.Fallout.compiler.outputDirectory.description: This is the output directory, inside the Data folder, where compiled scripts will be placed. If not set, the output will go to the same directory as the source script. WARNING: It is Highly recommended to set this to avoid issues with Fallout 4's script loading.
